usage: A common everyday noun for a necklace; use it for any necklace, whether simple or fancy.
Often used with verbs like 戴 and 送 when talking about wearing or giving jewellery.
Neutral, everyday vocabulary in Hong Kong Cantonese; suitable for both spoken and written use.
For learner tip: 頸鏈 refers specifically to the item worn around the neck, so it does not mean a chain in general.
